in_marathi.name: Vaibhav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Development, Progress, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vaibhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vasobhava’, Vaibhav means 'development' or 'progress'. It is a name that signifies prosperity and growth. In Hindu mythology, Vaibhav is also considered an epithet of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing his infinite power and ability to bestow material and spiritual wealth upon his devotees.
